criteria: 0 — Unrouteable or out of scope: the pitch lacks a discernible magazine subject or cannot be assigned to any desk; do not advance.
1 — Routeable but administratively incomplete: the appropriate desk is clear, but at least one required supporting item is missing; return for completion and do not advance.

2 — Administratively complete but editorially weak: all required materials are present, yet the premise, sourcing plan, or evidence is too thin for section-editor review; decline or request redevelopment.
3 — Ready for section review: correctly routed, administratively complete, and supported by a plausible premise, identified sourcing path, and relevant evidence; advance to the section editor.

4 — Commission-ready priority: meets level 3 and also demonstrates unusually strong documentation, timely significance, clear access, and a distinctive or exclusive angle; escalate to the managing editor for prompt commissioning consideration.
decision.instructions: Apply the ordered rubric exactly. Desk assignment follows the subject matter, not the writer’s requested desk. Select one level and include its routing and advancement consequence.

2 — Administratively complete but editorially weak: all required materials are present, yet the premise, sourcing plan, or evidence is too thin for section-editor review; decline or request redevelopment.
3 — Ready for section review: correctly routed, administratively complete, and supported by a plausible premise, identified sourcing path, and relevant evidence; advance to the section editor.

4 — Commission-ready priority: meets level 3 and also demonstrates unusually strong documentation, timely significance, clear access, and a distinctive or exclusive angle; escalate to the managing editor for prompt commissioning consideration.
decision.instructions: Apply the ordered rubric exactly. Desk assignment follows the subject matter, not the writer’s requested desk. Select one level and include its routing and advancement consequence.

"Case Note – Lost Property File #LP-2291

Item: Black Solis A5 mobile phone.
Found by: Transit operator Mara, bus route 42, 14 September.
Handling: A civic facility receptionist accepted the sealed bag and transferred it unopened to the lost-property custodian at the transit depot, the required storage location for bus finds.

Claimant: Ivo. He states he lost a black Solis A5 phone on bus 42 on 14 September — the item type, date, and location he describes match the item type, date, and location Mara recorded when she found the phone.

Serial records: Mara recorded the phone found on bus 42 as having serial identifier ENG-77291-Q. Ivo's purchase receipt lists the serial identifier for his lost phone as ENG-77291-Q.

Governing policy: Policy rates matches: High requires matching item type, date/location, and exact identifier; Medium has matching descriptive facts but a conflicting identifier; Low has only one matching fact; No Match has none. Release requires High confidence.

The custodian is now reviewing the file to decide whether to release the phone to Ivo."

input.state: On May 12, property claimant Lena Mora reported leaving a black umbrella on bus 41 on May 10, describing a wooden crook handle and red tape marked "LM." The transit operator had logged a dark umbrella found on that bus and date. A civic facility receptionist initially added "possible red band" from a phone inquiry. On May 13, the lost-property custodian physically inspected the stored item and updated the record: navy folding umbrella, straight plastic handle, no initials, orange inventory band applied after recovery, with a lining code newly recorded. This May 13 inspection is treated as the verified update that postdates and supersedes every earlier custody entry for the item. The complete decision record for Lena Mora's claim contains exactly four claimant-to-item comparisons: three circumstance comparisons, all of which agree, and one identifying-detail comparison. The lining code was never disclosed to Lena Mora before she reported it, and it is considered a distinctive identifying feature of the stored item. Lena Mora reported the stored item's lining code as pattern LC-7742-B. The May 13 physical-inspection update records the stored item's lining code as pattern LC-7742-B. Policy requires using the latest verified update when deciding release.
